test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph. Note: This is an advertisement of an ice-cream brand.

(A) That's why Silky is deliciously different and exceptionally versatile, natural, thick and durable ice cream.

(B) Beautifully firm, nice, silky rather than thin and watery, it stays in shape and stands on top of fruits or pastries without soaking in.

(C) Silky thick double ice cream has a unique, fresh taste and texture.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The paragraph begins by introducing the unique qualities of the ice cream.
 
• **Sentence C is the first sentence** as it sets the introduction:
 
 
• "Silky thick double ice cream has a unique, fresh taste and texture."
 
 
 
• **Sentence B follows** as it describes the specific characteristics of the ice cream:
 
 
• "Beautifully firm, nice, silky rather than thin and watery, it stays in shape and stands on top of fruits or pastries without soaking in."
 
 
 
• **Sentence A is the third sentence** as it concludes with why the ice cream is different:
 
 
• "That's why Silky is deliciously different and exceptionally versatile, natural, thick and durable ice cream."
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **CBA**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"Silky thick double ice cream has a unique, fresh taste and texture. Beautifully firm, nice, silky rather than thin and watery, it stays in shape and stands on top of fruits or pastries without soaking in. That's why Silky is deliciously different and exceptionally versatile, natural, thick and durable ice cream."
